summary: Automates building pre-configured MikroTik Cloud Hosted Router (CHR) disk images for AMD64 and ARM64. A GitHub Actions workflow detects new RouterOS releases, builds multi-arch images, and publishes unified releases. A Kubernetes CronJob (Python) checks MikroTik's download page via GitHub App auth and dispatches the workflow when a new version appears. A separate Docker container handles OCI VRRP failover by updating OCI route tables when a MikroTik VRRP master transition fires.

entrypoints.description: Kubernetes CronJob entry point: polls mikrotik.com/download for a new CHR version, authenticates as a GitHub App, and dispatches build-chr.yml when a new version is found.
Bootstraps a bare Linux host: downloads the latest CHR image from GitHub Releases and writes it to disk via dd.
Manual build helper: mounts the CHR image and injects the pre-generated startup.rsc configuration.
Generates a random admin password and writes it into startup.rsc before image injection.
Validates the built CHR image after injection.
Shell wrapper that checks MikroTik download page for the latest CHR version string.
HTTP server (POST /promote, GET /health) that updates OCI route tables on VRRP master promotion; runs inside the RouterOS container runtime.
Shell script that applies all Kubernetes manifests in k8s/ to deploy the version-checker CronJob.

modules.description: RouterOSVersionChecker class: fetches latest version from mikrotik.com, compares against a persisted version file, generates a GitHub App JWT, exchanges it for an installation token, and triggers a workflow_dispatch event.
OCI VRRP failover helper: minimal HTTP server that calls the OCI SDK to update route table next-hops when notified by RouterOS's on-master hook.
Unit tests for the OCI VRRP failover server.
RouterOS script injected into the CHR image: sets system identity, enables DHCP on ether1, enables SSH and API-SSL, and sets the admin password.
Primary CI workflow: detects latest CHR version, builds AMD64 and ARM64 images, and publishes a unified GitHub Release with both image assets.
Publishes the oci-vrrp-failover Docker image to a container registry.
Kubernetes CronJob manifest that schedules check_routeros_version.py.
Kubernetes ConfigMap holding non-secret configuration for the CronJob (e.g. GITHUB_REPO, WORKFLOW_ID).
Template for injecting the Python script into the cluster as a ConfigMap.
Template for the Kubernetes Secret holding GitHub App credentials (app ID and private key).
PersistentVolumeClaim for persisting the current-version file across CronJob runs.
Ad-hoc debug Pod manifest for troubleshooting the version-checker environment.
Builds the OCI VRRP failover container image.
Top-level Python dependencies for scripts/check_routeros_version.py (requests, PyJWT).
Python dependencies for the OCI VRRP failover server (oci SDK, etc.).

callgraph_highlights: MikroTik VRRP on-master hook -> POST http://172.17.0.3:8080/promote -> server.py:promote_handler -> OCI SDK update_route_table

Kubernetes CronJob -> check_routeros_version.py:main -> RouterOSVersionChecker.run -> get_latest_routeros_version + get_current_version -> generate_jwt -> get_installation_token -> trigger_workflow (build-chr.yml dispatch)
build-chr.yml check-version job -> scripts/check-version.sh; build jobs -> scripts/generate-password.sh + scripts/inject.sh + scripts/validate.sh -> GitHub Release

hotspots.reason: Core logic for version detection and workflow dispatch; most likely to need changes when GitHub App auth or MikroTik page structure changes.
OCI VRRP failover path; sensitive to OCI SDK API changes and route-table OCID configuration.
Main build and release pipeline; touched whenever build steps, architectures, or release asset layout changes.
Only file written into the CHR image; any default-config change must be made here.
